title: Blockchain Developer
tagline: Build smart contracts and decentralised applications, carefully.
about: Blockchain developers write smart contracts (programs that run on networks like Ethereum) and the applications around them. Because deployed contracts often hold value and can't easily be changed, the job is unusually focused on correctness, testing and security.
Learn the fundamentals of cryptography and distributed systems first; they outlast any particular chain or trend.
day: Write and test smart contracts in Solidity
Build web frontends that interact with contracts
